question: Which of the following is one of the Trustees of the PM CARES Fund?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Ratan N. Tata.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM CARES Fund** was created in **March 2020** to provide relief during the **COVID-19 pandemic** in India.
 
• The fund is managed by a trust, whose **trustees** are eminent persons from various fields, appointed by the **Prime Minister of India.**
 
• **Shri Ratan N. Tata**, a well-known** industrialist and philanthropist**, is one of the trustees of the PM CARES Fund.
 
• Shri Azim Premji, Shri Gautam Adani, and Shri Mukesh Ambani are also prominent business leaders in India, but they are **not trustees** of the PM CARES Fund.
 
• It's worth noting that the PM CARES Fund has been a** subject of controversy,** with some critics questioning its transparency and accountability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shri Azim Premji** is the founder and former chairman of **Wipro Limited,** a leading IT services company in India.

 
 
• He is also known for his **philanthropic activities, **particularly in the field of education. 
 
 
 
• **Shri Gautam Adani** is the chairman of th**e Adani Group,** a conglomerate with interests in **ports, logistics, energy, and other sectors**.
 
 
• The group has been involved in **several controversial projects**, including a proposed coal mine in Australia.
 
 
 
• **Shri Mukesh Ambani **is the chairman of **Reliance Industries**, India's largest private sector company, with interests in petrochemicals, refining, telecom, and retail.
 
 
• He is one of the** richest persons in the world **and has been involved in several high-profile business deals and controversies.
